ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S Slow Search builds on the validated JS1.1R baseline for RimWorld 1.5. Ordinary JobPackages retain JS1.1R behavior. Only JobGiver-owned GenClosest.ClosestThingReachable searches backed by a live ThingRequest source of at least 512 candidates may use the selective large-search path: candidates are stably ordered nearest-first, the original WorkGiver validator still runs on the main thread, and final reachability is checked with live map.reachability.CanReach. This targets the measured JobGiver tail spikes caused by ClosestThingReachable -> RegionTraverser while leaving small searches unchanged. JR1/JR1.1 Regionwise and global Region.Allows experiments remain retired. ReachProfile keeps JS1.1R prediction/build behavior and the embedded rolling 8192/8 soft fuse, 3600-frame live cooldown, 256-clean forced-shadow probation and 16/256 emergency hard fuse.
